records.description: Automatically monitor broken, redirected, or unsafe links whether they're YouTube links or manually imported links. An AI-powered "Mission Control" for affiliate marketers. Monitor prices, stock levels, and link health across any e-commerce site globally using AI and premium residential proxies.

records.name: AlignList
records.tagline: Latest AI Training Jobs and Career Resources
records.description: AlignList is a job board focused on AI training, data annotation, and evaluation roles. We aggregate opportunities from leading AI labs and data companies such as Scale AI, Mercor, Rise Data Labs, Micro1, and Surge AI, making hard to find training and evaluation roles easy to discover.

records.name: EvolForms
records.tagline: Forms that work offline, photos, conditional logic, and more
records.description: Are your field teams still using paper? EvolForms digitizes your forms with a mobile app that truly works offline. Create no-code forms, capture photos, signatures, GPS location and more. Even conditional logic to build forms that adapt to user responses. Perfect for maintenance, construction and field services. Automatic sync, real-time reports and support in 4 languages. Your digital office in the field.

records.name: MCP BridgeKit — Survive 30s Timeouts
records.tagline: HTTP bridge for MCP — no more 30s timeouts. Vercel ready.
records.description: Built this after my own MCP tools kept dying at the 30-second serverless timeout. MCP BridgeKit turns any stdio MCP server into a reliable HTTP endpoint with automatic queuing, session isolation, and instant job completion push (webhook + SSE). Key features: • Survives Vercel/AWS 30s hard limit • Per-user isolated MCP sessions • Live HTMX dashboard • Tool list caching • Works with any MCP server One-click Vercel deploy or docker-compose up. Would love feedback from the MCP community.

records.name: Hari
records.tagline: Tagalog, everywhere you browse.
records.description: Hari - Learn Tagalog through complete web immersion. A Chrome extension that translates everything you see online into Tagalog.

records.name: mAItion AI Knowledge Search
records.tagline: Unified AI Search Across All Knowledge Tools
records.description: mAItion enhances knowledge management by integrating with tools like Jira, Confluence, Notion, Gmail, Google Drive, S3, MediaWiki, and more, without replacing them. It breaks down silos for one source of truth, ingesting and indexing data for AI-powered retrieval and chat via Slack, Microsoft Teams, Open WebUI, and others. Secure answers with a robust MCP framework for productivity, real-time access, top security, and data privacy.

records.name: ImageAITool
records.tagline: Free AI Image Generator with no login
records.description: Free AI-powered image editing tools. Enhance photos, remove backgrounds, restore old images, sharpen, colorize, upscale and more. Professional results in seconds.

records.name: n8n Node Explorer
records.tagline: Discover the right n8n community node faster
records.description: Discover and search through thousands of n8n community nodes in one clean interface. Search by: • Node name • Package name • Resource name • Operation name Currently indexed: • 2,326 unique nodes • 2,922 unique resources • 9,061 unique operations Instead of jumping between npm, GitHub, and docs, just type what you want to do — like: “pdf to html” “whatsapp message” “image extraction” “generate audio” …and quickly find relevant nodes with contextual matches.

records.name: Salioto
records.tagline: Simple POS Inventory Software for Growing Shops.
records.description: Salioto: A solution to make setting up an inventory system easy for non-Technical people. Efficient sales, inventory, employee accounts management and analytics for modern businesses.

records.name: Appnalyze
records.tagline: Boost your app position on App Store and Play Store 🚀
records.description: Indie hackers don’t need more dashboards. They need installs. Appnalyze analyzes your App Store or Google Play listing and tells you exactly what to fix to increase conversions. No keyword theory. No vanity metrics. No fluff. Just: • Your biggest conversion blocker • 3 prioritized actions • A clarity score • Real user review insights • Suggested copy you can paste today Drop your app URL. Get actionable fixes in minutes. Built for indie makers who want growth without hiring an ASO agency.

records.name: Didit v3
records.tagline: One platform for KYC, biometrics & fraud. 70% lower costs.
records.description: Didit replaces fragmented identity tools with one platform. KYC, biometrics, liveness, and fraud detection orchestrated together — one source of truth, fewer manual reviews, faster onboarding. Works globally across devices and low connectivity. 500 free checks/month, pay-per-use after. No contracts. 1,000+ companies. GDPR & ISO 27001 certified.

records.name: UnveilDNS SaaS
records.tagline: DNS filtering that blocks malware, ads & trackers, no setup
records.description: Cloud-based DNS filtering that protects your network from malware, ads, and trackers. Multi-protocol support (DNS, DoH, DoT, DoQ) with real-time analytics and per-profile policies.
